question: In Table 1, which company is running the NBF-006 trial, and what is its status?

trace.query: SELECT id, table_id, row_no, col_no, is_header, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p2.T1' AND row_no IN (SELECT row_no FROM cells WHERE table_id='p2.T1' AND text ILIKE '%NBF%') ORDER BY row_no, col_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%NBF%' OR text ILIKE '%006%'
SELECT id, row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p2.T1' AND row_no BETWEEN 11 AND 14 ORDER BY row_no, col_no
SELECT id, page, line_no, text, x0 FROM lines WHERE page=2 AND top BETWEEN (SELECT top-5 FROM atoms WHERE id='p2.T1.r12c2') AND (SELECT top+60 FROM atoms WHERE id='p2.T1.r12c2') ORDER BY top, x0

SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page=2 AND (text ILIKE '%Completed%' OR text ILIKE '%Phase 1%' OR text ILIKE '%Nitto%' OR text ILIKE '%NCT03819387%' OR text ILIKE '%GSTP%' OR text ILIKE '%Pancreatic%')
SELECT id, kind, page, text FROM atoms WHERE id IN ('p2.T1.r12c6','p2.T1.r13c6','p2.T1.r12c7','p2.T1.r12c2') OR (page=2 AND text ILIKE '%Completed%')
